items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including five critical ones. The most severe, CVE-2026-103849 (BlockStrap), is a template engine injection allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code with a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This out-of-band security update resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650, StyleSmuggler) that could result in unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of active exploitation of this vulnerability in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including two stored cross-site scripting flaws. It also mentions the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362, CVSS 9.1) and two stored cross-site scripting flaws. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.
